texts.zh:
方舟舰的高级官员之一，[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]，对我们最近接触到的文明产生了一种超乎寻常的热情——如果一定要用语言形容的话。

无论是我们的仪器所能捕捉到的每一份文化记录，还是每一抹艺术或哲学的残片，都被其悉数吸收：

“我已经见识了足够多的东西，足以明白这里有着某种非凡的存在。让我去把剩下的补全吧。让我站在他们的世界里去学习。”
texts.en:
One of the Arkship's senior Officials, [event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName], has developed what can only be described as a profound passion for the civilization we have recently encountered.

Every cultural record, every scrap of art or philosophy our instruments could capture, they have absorbed it all:

"I have seen enough to know that there is something extraordinary here. Let me go and find the rest of it. Let me stand in their world and learn."

texts.zh:
方舟舰的一位高级官员，[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]，针对我们近期接触到的一个外星文明提出了一个不同寻常的建议。无论我们本能地对这一物种有多么厌恶，[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]认为，无知对我们毫无益处：

“我并不是要求去仰慕他们。我提议的是研究他们。了解一个潜在的对手，并不等同于尊重他们。”
texts.en:
One of the Arkship's senior Officials, [event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName], has put forward an unusual proposal regarding an alien civilization we have recently encountered. Whatever our instinctive distaste for this species, [event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName] argues that ignorance serves us poorly:

"I am not asking to admire them. I am proposing that we study them. To know a potential adversary is not the same as respecting one."

texts.zh:
方舟舰的高级官员之一，[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]，花了大量时间研究一个特定的外星文明，钻研拦截到的传输信号、文化记录，以及我们的外交官设法达成的少量交流。

[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]现在提议采取下一步行动：向他们的母星派遣一个正式代表团：“远距离了解一个物种与真正理解他们是有区别的。我希望能理解他们。”
texts.en:
One of the Arkship's senior Officials, [event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName], has spent considerable time studying a particular alien civilization, poring over intercepted transmissions, cultural records, and the sparse exchanges our diplomats have managed to broker.

[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName] is now proposing to take the next step: a formal delegation to their homeworld: "There is a difference between knowing a people from afar and truly understanding them. I wish to understand them."

texts.zh:
方舟舰已抵达[solar_system.GetName]。

据报告，自从远程传感器解析出该恒星系以后，[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]就一直没有离开过观测平台。当地政府已表示欢迎。
texts.en:
The Arkship has arrived at [solar_system.GetName].

[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName] has reportedly not left the observation deck since the system resolved on the long-range sensors. The local government has extended a welcome.

texts.zh:
方舟舰已抵达[solar_system.GetName]。当地人以他们特有的方式表达了欢迎。

[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]曾涉足过更怪异的地方。那种厌恶感如今已变得熟悉，但将其搁置一旁以完成使命的自律感同样如此。

我们已身处此地。让我们看看能达成什么目标。
texts.en:
The Arkship has arrived at [solar_system.GetName]. The locals have offered what passes for a welcome among their kind.

[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName] has walked into stranger places. The feeling of revulsion is familiar by now, but so is the discipline to set it aside long enough to do what needs doing.

We are here. Let us see what we can achieve.

texts.zh:
方舟舰已抵达[solar_system.GetName]，当地政府的代表表示了谨慎的欢迎。

[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]一直以来筹划的时刻已经到来。这次接触可能在双方人民之间开启一条真正的沟通渠道，也可能仅仅被双方视作一段奇特的陈年往事而淡忘。下一步将由我们迈出。
texts.en:
The Arkship has arrived at [solar_system.GetName] and representatives of the local government have extended a cautious welcome.

The moment [event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName] has been planning for is here. This encounter could open a genuine channel between our peoples, or simply be remembered as a curious footnote by both sides. The next step is ours to take.

label.en: The timing is not right. Stand down.

texts.zh:
[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]是一位引人注目的贵客。坦率地说，我们很舍不得此人离开。

我们想提出一个建议：允许[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]永久留在我们这里，作为我们两国人民之间真正的使节。我们明白这一请求并非小事。为了表达诚意，我们将提供一份小礼以表感激之情。

请将此视为我们建立持久友谊的定金。
texts.en:
[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName] has been a remarkable guest. Frankly, we are reluctant to see them go.

We would like to make a proposal: allow [event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName] to remain with us permanently, as a true ambassador between our peoples. We understand this is no small thing to ask. As a gesture of our sincerity, we offer you a small token of our gratitude.

Consider this a down payment on a lasting friendship.

label.zh: 我们的官员必须留在我们政府内。
label.en: Our official must return with us.

texts.zh:
我们将直截了当地说明。访问期间出现了一些困难，使得贵方代表不宜继续留任。

[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]已被要求离开。我们希望此事不会演变成你我之间更大的问题。
texts.en:
We will be direct. Certain difficulties have arisen during the visit that make it inadvisable for your representative to remain.

[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName] has been asked to leave. We hope this need not become a larger matter between us.

label.zh: 我们的官员表现很得体。

texts.zh:
这……是一件棘手的事情。我们的一员主动找到我们，正式请求在你们启程时搭乘你们的飞船一同离开。

我们不会假装这听起来很容易接受。[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]显然给人留下了深刻的印象。我们将此事告知你，是因为我们认为应当由你来做出选择。
texts.en:
This is... a delicate matter. One of our own has come to us and formally asked to leave with your vessel when you depart.

We will not pretend this is easy to hear. [event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName] has clearly made an impression. We are bringing this to you because we believe the choice is yours to make.

label.zh: 此人应当与自己的族人在一起。
label.en: Their place is with their people.
